CustomField.description: Number of months since the Most Recent Win Date. Most Recent Win Date is is the most recent close date of a closed won, non-upsell opportunity. Blank if Pro Account Cancelled Date is more recent. S3P-1293 - Created. S3P-1388 - Helptext updated.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of months since the Most Recent Win Date. (Red: 3-5, Yellow: 6-11, Green: 12+ months. Accounts under 3 months are too new to score.)
CustomField.label: Tenure (Months)
